say:1:1230161001:1.text: This one is free! Well, I won't say no if you want to tip me.
say:1:1230161001:1.source_cn: 这条好消息免费！但如果你听完好消息之后坚持打赏，我也不...

say:2:1230161002:1.text: The good news is that the Carmine Whispers have got rid of the Dead Tide Fleet!
say:2:1230161002:1.source_cn: 好消息就是，死潮舰队被血薇帮赶走了！

say:3:1230161003:1.text: There's also word that the Carmine Whispers are trying to collaborate with the Water Wights...
say:3:1230161003:1.source_cn: 还有消息说，血薇帮在试图和水鬼帮达成合作……

say:4:1230161004:1.text: Hard to believe, right? But if they can call the fighting quits and bring peace to the place, more will come out and buy my papers!
say:4:1230161004:1.source_cn: 挺奇怪的，对吧？但是如果他们能不打来打去，太太平平的，...
